sharedFailure: qualification revision must be one exact non-merge source commit, not a synthetic merge revision
rootCause: The K5 job used the default shallow actions/checkout history. The candidate commit was the shallow boundary, so git rev-list --parents could not observe its single parent and the fail-closed finalizer rejected all four hosts as unverifiable.
sharedSuccessfulSteps: set up exact JDK 21 qualification runtime
requiredCorrection: Fetch at least the candidate parent in the K5 checkout step, retain the non-merge finalizer check, and rerun all four native jobs on the corrected immutable revision.
